findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: caselaw_datasets · Private data: appeal_outcome, appeal_stats, ask_graph, caselaw_datasets, caselaw_files, caselaw_opinion, cases_citing, citation_lookup, citation_suggest, cited_by, coverage, docket_counsel, docket_lookup, enforcement, entity_lookup, filings_count, filings_series, judge_motions, judge_pace, judge_report, judge_stats, lawsuits_naming, magistrate_report, matter, new_filings, news, parties, prose_stats, representation_stats, top_cited, validity · Public sink: appeal_stats, coverage, prose_stats, representation_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: caselaw_datasets · Private data: appeal_outcome, appeal_stats, ask_graph, caselaw_datasets, caselaw_files, caselaw_opinion, cases_citing, citation_lookup, citation_suggest, cited_by, coverage, docket_counsel, docket_lookup, enforcement, entity_lookup, filings_count, filings_series, judge_motions, judge_pace, judge_report, judge_stats, lawsuits_naming, magistrate_report, matter, new_filings, news, parties, prose_stats, representation_stats, top_cited, validity · Public sink: appeal_stats, coverage, prose_stats, representation_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
